state.criteria: Compare choices fairly: byte compatibility of actual accepted stored API, minimal authoring/API/lifecycle changes, native equal-byte primitives, complete current Node>=22/workerd support, delivery complexity and explicit uncertainty. No speculative exploitable auth claim or assumed legacy credentials.

encoding.question: Choose the defensible treatment of accepted nonzero unused password-encoding bits during this library migration.

criteria.preserve_public_tails: Keep existing public decoder acceptance, including stored password aliases, using a bounded validated final-character bit mask then strict library decoding; retain canonical encoder. Do not normalize bearer text. Avoids any decode API break but keeps a narrow compatibility adapter.
criteria.strict_everywhere: Strict public and password decoding immediately, accepting canonical issued hashes unchanged but rejecting currently accepted tail aliases; explicit breaking stored acceptance correction without known affected record. Simplest adapter.
criteria.password_only_compat: Tighten public decoder but preserve tails only inside password parser via private compatibility helper; prevents stored break but changes public API acceptance and adds a second decode policy.

host.question: Select the least disruptive way to supply synchronous native secret comparisons in both supported hosts.

criteria.conditional_native: Keep >=22. Use explicit Node/default host entry or conditional private import resolving Node timingSafeEqual vs Worker subtle primitive. No static Node import in neutral closure; root must qualify conditional resolution, direct-source tests and delivery. More wiring, preserves full Node range.
criteria.explicit_floor: Use Worker subtle primitive first and Node global process.getBuiltinModule crypto lookup otherwise; explicitly raise supported Node floor to22.3 and root manifest contract, fail visibly when unavailable. Simple neutral module/no static Node import but drops22.0-22.2.
criteria.retain_and_hold: Retain existing JS loop with accurate no-native-guarantee comments and hold I03 until a host binding can be qualified; no support-range change, but required native comparison adoption incomplete.
